task: The caller wants a competitor's repository torn down into a feature inventory they can compare against their own product.
query: tear down this competitor's repo into a feature inventory
rationale: reverse-engineer is the only skill whose contract is an authorized teardown of an external repo into a feature inventory; 'tear down' and 'competitor' are its own trigger words. research is the plausible confusion (an external question with evidence), but it answers a bounded question and its description now routes codebase dissection away explicitly and shares no token with the query (ao skills find prefix-stems at 4 runes, so 'repository' would hit 'repo' and 'teardown' would hit 'tear'; the negative sentence deliberately avoids both). codebase-recon traces the caller's own repository, so it is pinned out of rank 1.
notes: Added 2026-09-03 alongside the negative routing sentences on research, codebase-recon, and reverse-engineer; the pair this golden pins is research vs reverse-engineer.
